wiki.title: Jay Luneau
wiki.extract: Wendell Jay Luneau is an American lawyer, educator, and politician serving as a member of the Louisiana State Senate from the 29th district since 2016. A member of the Democratic Party, he represents parts of seven parishes in Central Louisiana. Before his election, Luneau practiced law in Alexandria, taught as an adjunct professor at Northwestern State University, and served as a magistrate judge in Ball.
